# discord_audit_log (Data Source)

Reads entries from a server's audit log, for example to check who changed a setting outside Terraform. The bot needs the View Audit Log permission. Discord keeps entries for 45 days.

Entries are newest first, or oldest first when `after` is set. Change values vary by action and field, so they are JSON-encoded; decode them with `jsondecode`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The 50 most recent bans (action type 22) and their reasons.
data "discord_audit_log" "bans" {
  server_id   = var.server_id
  action_type = 22
}

output "ban_reasons" {
  value = { for e in data.discord_audit_log.bans.entries : e.target_id => e.reason }
}

# Changes to a role made outside Terraform, with old and new values decoded.
data "discord_audit_log" "role_updates" {
  server_id   = var.server_id
  action_type = 31
  limit       = 200
}

output "role_changes" {
  value = [
    for e in data.discord_audit_log.role_updates.entries : {
      by      = e.user_id
      changes = { for c in e.changes : c.key => c.new_value == null ? null : jsondecode(c.new_value) }
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).

### Optional

- `action_type` (Number) Only return entries of this [audit log event](https://docs.discord.com/developers/resources/audit-log#audit-log-entry-object-audit-log-events) type, such as `22` for bans.
- `after` (String) Only return entries with an ID higher than this entry ID. Entries are then returned oldest first.
- `before` (String) Only return entries with an ID lower than this entry ID.
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of entries to return. Defaults to 50. Discord returns at most 100 per request, so higher limits take several requests.
- `user_id` (String) Only return entries for actions by this user or app.

### Read-Only

- `entries` (Attributes List) Audit log entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `action_type` (Number) Audit log event type.
- `changes` (Attributes List) Changes made to the target. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries--changes))
- `id` (String) Entry ID.
- `options` (Map of String) Additional information for some event types, such as `channel_id` or `count`.
- `reason` (String) Reason given for the change.
- `target_id` (String) ID of the affected object, such as a role, channel or user.
- `user_id` (String) ID of the user or app that made the change.

<a id="nestedatt--entries--changes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries.changes`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) Name of the changed field.
- `new_value` (String) JSON-encoded value after the change, or null if it was reset.
- `old_value` (String) JSON-encoded value before the change, or null if it was null.
